title: Silk & Velvet
description: Urban intrigue across the trade-bridge city of Silkstrand, a night of high etiquette at Ravenswood Manor, and the stair-ruled metropolis of Thepyrgos. The players must navigate contracts, masks, and glamour to prevent a ritual that would swap the souls of the city's elite.
author: Nicholas A. Gasper

bestiary.name: Glamour Ghost
bestiary.description: An illusion given form, used by the Crimson Masque troupe to confuse and misdirect.

sb_spends.name: Illusory Double
sb_spends.effect: Create a duplicate that forces opponents to reroll attacks.

acts.title: A Song of Poison and Plague
acts.description: Urban investigation as the Gemcutters and Alchemists edge toward riots, while a bard of Desire plays both sides.

scenes.title: The Redwater Audit
scenes.description: The party must enter the dyeworks with forged or earned permits to investigate the source of the poisoned water.

outcomes.clean: You gain entry and find evidence linking the alchemists to the poison.
outcomes.partial: You enter but alert a guard; tick City Unrest +1.

scenes.title: The Alleyway Serenade
scenes.description: Sel Virelle 'rescues' a bystander to win the party's trust. Reading her tells can downshift DV.

outcomes.clean: You see through her performance and gain leverage over her.
outcomes.partial: You earn her trust but she escapes your scrutiny.
outcomes.miss: She charms you and gains a hold on the party.

acts.title: The Gilded Cage
acts.description: A night of velvet hospitality at Ravenswood Manor. Each room is a social encounter with taboos and tells.

scenes.title: Conservatory of Masks
scenes.description: Choose alliances and navigate the etiquette of masks. Violating taboos advances Etiquette Breach.

outcomes.clean: You gain an important alliance and learn a rival's schedule.
outcomes.partial: You avoid insult but miss a key clue.
outcomes.miss: You commit a faux pas; tick Etiquette Breach +1.

acts.title: The Crimson Masque
acts.description: A public ritual threatens to swap souls. The party must infiltrate rehearsals and stop the rite on stage.

scenes.title: The On-Stage Challenge
scenes.description: Dismantle the ritual pillars (Bell Cadence, Mask Index, Applause Escrow) before the final bell.

outcomes.clean: You stop the ritual and expose the Masque Director.
outcomes.partial: You stop it but at great cost; some souls are swapped.
outcomes.miss: The ritual completes; the city's elite are replaced.

npcs.name: Guildmistress Kavra
npcs.secret: She knows about the poison but sees it as a way to discredit the Alchemists.

npcs.name: Master Orun
npcs.secret: He is producing the poison but blames the Gemcutters.

npcs.name: Sel Virelle
npcs.secret: She is orchestrating the chaos for the Crimson Masque.

locations.name: Silkstrand
locations.description: A city of canals, dyed waterways, and legal bridges. Permits and seals are visible power.

locations.name: Ravenswood Manor
locations.description: A noble estate where the party must survive a night of velvet hospitality and intricate social traps.

locations.name: Thepyrgos
locations.description: A stair-ruled metropolis where bell-law and stair-rights can crown or crush reputations overnight.

factions.name: The Crimson Masque
factions.goals: Swap souls of the elite for power.

campaignTimers.name: Sel's Glamour Net
campaignTimers.description: Advances when Sel gains influence over the party or city.

campaignTimers.name: Midnight Duel
campaignTimers.description: Advances as the rival's plot reaches its peak.

campaignTimers.name: Etiquette Breach
campaignTimers.description: Advances when the party violates social taboos at Ravenswood.

campaignTimers.name: Act Countdown
campaignTimers.description: Advances as the performance night approaches.

notes: Urban intrigue module with strong social mechanics. Can be run as three separate arcs or a single campaign. Emphasis on Position, DV, and leverage via Diamonds.

pacing.act1: This is the investigation phase. The poison is a symptom, not the cause—guild tensions are the real battlefield. Sel Virelle is a charming antagonist; she should seem helpful until the party reads her tells or investigates her. The Crimson Masque is a shadow—their name may be whispered, but their true goal (soul-swapping) is an Act III discovery. Emphasize the City Unrest timer: the streets are a powder keg. The Gemcutters and Alchemists are both guilty and both victims—avoid a simple 'good vs evil' framing.
pacing.act2: Ravenswood Manor is a social pressure cooker. The Etiquette Breach timer is the primary threat—violating taboos invites consequences, but breaking them strategically may open doors. The Conservatory of Masks is a chance to build alliances and gather intelligence. The Midnight Duel timer represents the rival's plot coming to a head—it's not a literal duel unless the party makes it one. Sel's Glamour Net may still be active; if she charmed the party in Act I, this is where she cashes in that hold. The Crimson Masque's ritual mechanics (Bell Cadence, Mask Index, Applause Escrow) should remain abstract until Act III.
pacing.act3: This is the climax. The Act Countdown timer creates urgency—the ritual is underway, and the party must dismantle its pillars. Breaking the pillars requires understanding the ritual's structure (gained through investigation in Acts I-II). The three pillars are mechanical challenges: Bell Cadence (disrupt timing), Mask Index (expose the performers), Applause Escrow (turn the audience). The ending should reflect the party's choices: a clean success exposes the Masque Director; a partial success swaps some souls (a haunting consequence); a miss means the city's elite are replaced by the Masque's agents.

npcSecrets.guildmistress-kavra: Her secret (using the poison to discredit the Alchemists) is a mid-Act I discovery if the party investigates her. It makes her a potential ally—or a target—depending on the party's morals. She is not a villain; she is a pragmatist.
npcSecrets.master-orun: His secret (producing the poison but blaming the Gemcutters) is a parallel to Kavra's. The truth is that both guilds are being manipulated by the Crimson Masque. This revelation should land in Act II or early Act III.
npcSecrets.sel-virelle: Her secret (orchestrating chaos for the Crimson Masque) is the Act II/III linchpin. If the party reads her tells in Act I, they may suspect her; if they fail, her charm offensive continues. She should be a mirror to the party—talented, ambitious, and willing to burn the city for a stage.

forbiddenEarlyRevelations: The Crimson Masque's soul-swapping ritual — Act III only
That Sel Virelle is working for the Crimson Masque — Act II/III reveal
The specific mechanics of the ritual pillars (Bell Cadence, Mask Index, Applause Escrow) — Act III only
The poison's true source is the Crimson Masque manipulating both guilds — Act II/III discovery
Ravenswood Manor's hidden passages or secrets — should be discovered through exploration, not exposited
